Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to submit our offer for your consideration. We can offer you a price of €5.74 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, and a contract term of 12 months.

As a valued partner, we always strive to support your operations with our extensive inventory and reliable delivery service. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our successful business relationship and standing by as your trusted partner for all your supply needs.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for explaining your position.

Our data shows a different picture on some points:
Your rolling scorecard shows on-time delivery of 88.6% (sc:70610@2026Q3).
Our demand forecast for this part has risen 15.3% (fc:360011@2026-09).

Please find our proposal below.

We look forward to your reply.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

Thank you for sharing the updated demand forecast and your proposal for a 36-month contract. We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We also checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. 

We are pleased to accommodate the extended 60-day payment terms and the longer contract duration. In light of the increased volume and these new terms, we can revise our offer to a price of €5.55 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 36 months. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to?

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

move.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your revised offer and the additional step towards us. We always appreciate working with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and are eager to support your needs with our broad product range and dedicated service.

We are prepared to lower our price to €5.35 per unit for the requested 36-month contract and 60-day payment terms. Our offer is a price of €5.35 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 36 months. Please note that this offer remains valid for 7 days. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.

Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2594, LCI-C. To help us bridge the remaining gap, we kindly ask you to confirm the binding volume you can commit to. Which volume can you commit to? A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

decisions.tactician: The supplier is open and still conceding at a steady pace, so accepting now would leave value on the table. The volume itself is fixed, so we offer the multi-year term as the commitment it is asking for. No new arguments are left to cite.
